name: Daan
source: Adored by everyone she meets, Egg lives in a resplendent golden castle and appears to be the perfect heroine. Yet she holds few convictions of her own, and as Zero observes, she may for now be regarded as a lovely doll without thoughts of her own. In the Answer Space, a realm of pure white light, she alone remains in shadow, the only darkness within the light.
